DSH_HOME.description: DeepSeek Harness home for sessions, profiles, and settings. Must be on the attached volume.

DSH_WORKSPACE.description: Default session workspace for agent file work. Must be on the attached volume.

HOME.description: Process HOME so agent tools write under the volume instead of /root.

OPENCODE_PUBLIC_KEY.description: OpenCode Zen API key. Use the literal value public for free keyless models.

NODE_OPTIONS.description: Node.js heap limit for DSH (keep capped on small memory plans).

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Optional Telegram BotFather token for the bot sidecar. Leave empty if unused.

DSH_TRUST_ALL.description: Treat public service URLs as trusted so the full web UI works outside localhost.
